name: anim_dobe_settle
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of thick glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks, very broad chest, its lower body melting into a puddle, no legs
desc: Relaxes from the pose: the raised hand lowers slowly to the side and closes into a fist, the sticky strands between the fingers stretch and snap, the tongue slides back in and the mouth closes into a sly smirk. Slow and gooey.
